integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally. [Shot 1] Cinematic Chinese celestial palace, ethereal xianxia realm in the heavenly court, vast architecture dwarfing tiny human figures, when the shot centers on a figure: medium or close shot of a fictional xianxia character in flowing robes, colossal architecture and mist still towering behind, three-tier spatial layers: foreground columns/archways framing, middle sea of clouds, background grand palace silhouette at horizon, strict central-axis symmetry, one-point perspective vanishing to infinity, at least one floating structure (sky bridge, cloud terrace, floating island), cold blue-gray low-saturation environment, moon white and ice blue tones, high-saturation warm accents only on character costumes (vermilion, emerald, gold), diffused soft light with ethereal mist, no harsh shadows, descending sacred light beams, subtle rim light on flowing robes, deep blue night sky with cold moonlight, misty atmospheric depth. The camera executes a slow push-in with small amplitude at slow speed, unfolding the composition left-to-right within the frame. In the foreground, a stone dragon pillar slides past the right edge, creating a dynamic blur that frames the scene. The midground features a fictional xianxia figure (S1) wearing a high-saturation vermilion silk robe, standing in profile on a bridge, hand resting on the railing. The figure's face is in sharp focus, showing a serene expression, while the robe displays fine, realistic silk folds and soft diffusion. Behind the figure, the bridge splits into three distinct floating paths leading to distant islands, shrouded in thick, semi-transparent mist. The background reveals colossal celestial architecture in low-saturation ice blue and stone grey, with a deep blue night sky above. The lighting is dominated by cold blue tones (70%), with strong side Tyndall effects cutting through the fog, highlighting the wet, cold stone texture of the bridge. The only high-saturation warm light is the figure's robe and faint, distant lanterns on the islands. The figure remains mostly still, gently swaying with the wind, serving as the visual anchor amidst the vast, empty celestial expanse. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A vast, hollow wind howling softly across the stone bridge, mixed with the deep, resonant hum of celestial energy. The sound of silk fabric fluttering gently in the breeze is crisp and clear. A low, mystical ambient drone underpins the scene, suggesting the weight of the heavenly court. Faint, distant chimes echo from the mist, fading in and out to create a sense of immense depth and ethereal distance. The atmosphere is cold, quiet, and profoundly majestic, with the wind providing a constant, subtle movement cue.
